items.title: LSEG to acquire data provider Octus for $3.5bn
items.snippet: The London Stock Exchange (LSEG) has agreed to acquire credit data provider Octus in a cash deal worth $3.535bn.

items.title: Quantexa wins contract from Insolvency Service
items.snippet: Quantexa, the global data, analytics and AI software company pioneering Decision Intelligence, has been selected by the Insolvency Service for a multi-million-pound, three-year partnership.

items.title: Model ML opens Dubai office
items.snippet: Model ML, the agentic operating system for financial and professional services, is expanding in the Middle East with a new Dubai office and the appointment of Raghav Sehgal as General Manager for the region.

items.title: Qashier launches AI general manager
items.snippet: Qashier, the unified merchant operating system serving more than 25,000 businesses across Southeast Asia, today launched QashierGM, an AI general manager that works with a merchant's whole team.

items.title: Commercial Bank of Dubai joins CBMT Network
items.snippet: Commercial Bank of Dubai’s (CBD) participation in the Commercial Bank Money Token (CBMT) initiative marks the first Middle East bank joining the network, extending CBMT beyond Europe.

items.title: Mavka Capital appoints VP
items.snippet: Mavka Capital, a Silicon Valley-based corporate finance and M&A advisory firm focused on mergers and acquisitions, growth financing, and capital raising for growth-stage companies, is pleased to announce that Cristian Palmeiro has been promoted to Vice President.

items.title: Fintechs top banks and stablecoins for cheap cross-border payment - BIS research
items.snippet: Cross-border payments remain slow and expensive but fintech outfits such as Wise and Remitly have substantially cut costs relative to traditional retail bank wires while stabelcoins still suffer from issues with friction, according to BIS research.
